roadmap.title: Story and early tasks
roadmap.description: Play the story through Act 3 on any difficulty. Talk to 10 scouts before buying any Cartography maps, and pick up the quick tasks that come up: plants, supply drop, ethanol tanker, outpost scavenge, Timber, Horatio, smoke grenades, takedowns and the first Enforcer.

roadmap.title: Free-roam collections and upgrades
roadmap.description: After the story, spend Ethanol on Prosperity, then buy maps and finish the treasure hunts, photographs, MP3 players, hunting, fishing and Guns for Hire. Fill the perk list, craft your first legendary item, and finish your first Expedition.

roadmap.title: Combat feats with upgraded gear
roadmap.description: With legendary gear and the Act 2 perks, finish the combat feats: Piercing Ammo headshot, thrown shields, saw launcher kills, Wrath kills, aerial takedown, long-range arrow, bayonet finisher and the Leap of Faith fall.

roadmap.title: Rank III outposts and expeditions
roadmap.description: Run every outpost and expedition up to Rank III, find Sam Fisher's outfit in the Government Plane Wreck expedition, and complete 3 expeditions with a co-op partner.

achievements.description: Help Carmina get back to her mother in Prosperity. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Play through the Prologue until it ends. The achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Upgrade and secure Prosperity. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish the Act 1 story mission @mechanic{Under Siege}.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Play Act 1 through the mission @mechanic{Under Siege}. The achievement unlocks when it ends.

achievements.description: Bring the Father back to New Eden. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish the Act 2 story mission @mechanic{Joseph's Secret}.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Play Act 2 through the mission @mechanic{Joseph's Secret}. The achievement unlocks when it ends.

achievements.description: Solve the biggest problem in Hope County by defeating the Twins. Host only.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Twins, @enemy{Mickey} and @enemy{Lou}, in the Act 3 mission @mechanic{Problem Solver}.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. Two ammo crates refill ammo and medkits as often as you like: one stands on the road in the middle, the other on the hill where the mission begins.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Mickey}, the sniper, first. Climb the ladder on the back of her house and empty a magazine of a heavy machine gun into her.
Repeat the same attack on @enemy{Lou}, the flamethrower boss.

achievements.description: Decide the fate of the Father. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish the story and decide the Father's fate.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Play the final mission to the end and make the choice about the Father's fate.

achievements.description: Recover Grace's prototype gun and welcome her back to Prosperity for good. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish Grace's recruitment mission by recovering her prototype gun.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. Her quest also gives you your first saw launcher.

steps.text: Start @npc{Grace}'s recruitment mission from its map marker (available in Act 1) and finish it.

achievements.description: Return Selene's valuable stash. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish Selene's recruitment mission by returning her stash.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Start @npc{Selene}'s recruitment mission from its map marker (available in Act 1) and finish it.

achievements.description: Help Bean get back his business plan so he can set up his intel network in Prosperity. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish Bean's recruitment mission by getting back his business plan.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. Once Bean is recruited, the Cartography Center in @loc{Prosperity} can sell the treasure map and the monstrous animal maps.

steps.text: Start @npc{Bean}'s recruitment mission from its map marker (available in Act 1) and finish it.

achievements.description: Reunite Nick Rye with Carmina and Kim. Host only.
achievements.summary: Finish Nick Rye's recruitment mission by reuniting him with Carmina and Kim.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. Rescuing Nick also gives you his wingless plane.

steps.text: Start @npc{Nick Rye}'s recruitment mission from its map marker (available in Act 1) and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete your first Expedition to force the Highwaymen out of a stronghold.
achievements.summary: Complete one Expedition.

steps.text: Upgrade the Expeditions facility in @loc{Prosperity}, then talk to the helicopter pilot there.

Start an Expedition from the Journal. Run to the pink smoke signal and grab the package. Then head for an extraction point and wait there for the helicopter. Your start, the package and the extraction point are all random.

achievements.description: Gather intel 10 times by talking to Wiki-Bean-ia scouts. Host only.
achievements.summary: Talk to Wiki-Bean-ia scouts to gather intel 10 times.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. @warn{Missable.} Scouts stop appearing once every map location is revealed, either by buying all the Cartography maps or by finding every place yourself. Only a new game brings them back, so finish this before you buy maps.

steps.text: Look for a scout with a blue diamond icon; the compass shows when one is nearby. They show up out in the wild and at outposts you have freed. Talk to every one you see.
Quick method: fast travel back to @loc{Prosperity}, speak to the scout near the front gates, and do it again until you reach 10.

achievements.description: Loot a Highwaymen Supply Drop. Be careful, it won't be unguarded!
achievements.summary: Loot a Highwaymen supply drop.

steps.text: Travel to an animal hunting spot and wait there for 1 to 2 minutes. A plane drops a crate, marked by yellow smoke and a red marker.
Defeat the guards who come for it, then hold the interact button at the crate to loot it.

achievements.description: Gather 15 plants growing in Hope County. It's the closest thing to a pharmacy we have nowadays.
achievements.summary: Gather 15 plants in Hope County.

steps.text: Walk through the wilderness and pick plants: Yucca near forests, Bougainvillea near lakes and rivers, and Cistanche in caves and along roads. About 10 minutes is enough.

achievements.description: Scavenge an Outpost. You can always reclaim it. Host only.
achievements.summary: Scavenge a captured outpost.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Capture any outpost.
Interact with the workbench in it to scavenge it. The outpost resets, you get 50 Ethanol, and the achievement unlocks at once. Enemies retake it at a higher difficulty, and you can capture it again.

achievements.displayName: Home is Where the Part Is
achievements.description: Upgrade Prosperity's infrastructure for the first time by investing in the right parts. Host only.
achievements.summary: Spend Ethanol on the first upgrade of Prosperity's infrastructure.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Collect Ethanol from outposts, supply drops and Ethanol tankers, and spend it on an upgrade at @loc{Prosperity}. This happens during Act 1 and the achievement unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Drive with Timber for a total of 5 minutes. Just don't take him to the vet.
achievements.summary: Spend 5 minutes in total driving with Timber riding in the sidecar.

steps.text: Go to Meatfort, east of the Broken Forge outpost, where @mechanic{Man Eat Dog World} begins as a side mission. Complete it to recruit @npc{Timber}.
At a Garage in a liberated outpost, craft the Rusty Sidecar (first on the vehicle list) and spawn it. You cannot spawn vehicles at @loc{Prosperity}.
Set Timber as your active companion and climb on the motorcycle. Once he hops into the sidecar, drive around. Separate rides add together until you reach 5 minutes.

achievements.description: Commandeer an Ethanol tanker and bring it back to one of your outposts.
achievements.summary: Take an Ethanol tanker truck and drive it into one of your outposts.

steps.text: Wait on a road next to a captured outpost until a tanker truck drives by. This can take a few minutes.
Kill nearby enemies first, then the driver, because the tanker explodes easily. Take the truck and drive it into the outpost.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Treasure Hunt missions. Host only.
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Treasure Hunt missions.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. Each hunt gives 3 perk points. Some hunts need the Grapple perk, or fire from a burning arrow, incendiary rounds or the repair torch.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Bean}, then upgrade the Cartography Center in @loc{Prosperity} and buy the treasure map to see all 10 hunts.

@mechanic{Riddle Me Fish} is an easy pick. Go into the shed, then take the ladder down. Then press the six fish fast, starting with green, then orange and purple, and finishing with black, blue and yellow. Take too long and the gas catches fire.
@mechanic{Going Haywire} is another: shoot the door padlock from the rooftop, enter, turn off the electric machine with the switch inside, then take the ladder down to the stash.
Finish any 3 hunts in total.

achievements.description: Picklock 5 safes. With no more banks, it's the closest thing you'll get to experiencing a heist.
achievements.summary: Pick the lock on 5 safes.

steps.text: Buy the Lock Picking perk.
Open any 5 safes. They are in the treasure rooms of Treasure Hunts and at many named places in the world.

achievements.description: Recruit all Guns For Hire. Host only.
achievements.summary: Recruit all 8 Guns for Hire.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. @warn{Bugged:} for some players the achievement does not unlock, or the menu sticks at 7 of 8. Back up your save before recruiting the last one, so you can restore it and try again. Scouts show these locations on the map.

collectibles.name: Carmina Rye
collectibles.location: Your companion from the start of the game.
collectibles.method: Automatic.

collectibles.name: The Judge
collectibles.location: Joins you after the Act 2 mission @mechanic{Joseph's Secret}.
collectibles.method: Automatic.

collectibles.name: Pastor Jerome
collectibles.location: @loc{Ramone's Lookout}, just east of Rye & Daughter Aviation.
collectibles.method: Finish the side mission @mechanic{Jerome Comes Home}.

collectibles.name: Nana
collectibles.location: @loc{Nana's Perch}, south-east down the hill from the Signal Point outpost.
collectibles.method: Finish the side mission @mechanic{Crow's Feet, Eagle's Eyes}.

collectibles.name: Hurk Drubman Jr.
collectibles.location: On the map edge directly east of the Trailer Town outpost, in front of a tunnel.
collectibles.method: Finish the side mission @mechanic{Days of Blunder}.

collectibles.name: Timber
collectibles.location: @loc{Meatfort}, east of the Broken Forge outpost.
collectibles.method: Arriving triggers @mechanic{Man Eat Dog World}, a side mission. Complete it.

collectibles.name: Horatio
collectibles.location: @loc{Elsinore Farm}, north-west of The Pantry outpost.
collectibles.method: Arriving starts @mechanic{To Love a Boar} as a side mission. Shoot the shed padlock, then pet him.

collectibles.name: Gina Guerra
collectibles.location: Her quest appears at @loc{Prosperity} at the start of Act 2.
collectibles.method: Finish the side mission @mechanic{Mo' Mommies, Mo' Problems}.
collectibles.note: Needs the Specialist Sharky recruited first.

achievements.description: Craft 10 Medkits. They'll definitely come in handy.
achievements.summary: Craft 10 Medkits.

steps.text: Craft Medkits in the Consumables menu. Each needs Bougainvillea, Cistanche and meat from animals.
Craft up to your carry limit, use them (healing at full health works), and craft again until you have made 10 in total.

achievements.description: Kill a Monstrous animal. It'd do the same to you given half the chance.
achievements.summary: Kill one Monstrous animal.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Bean}, upgrade the Cartography Center in @loc{Prosperity}, and buy the monstrous animal map.
Go to a marked Monstrous Bison, Boar, Bear or Cougar (yellow health bar) and kill one. A legendary weapon makes this much easier.

achievements.description: Find Sam Fisher’s outfit in the Government Plane Wreck expedition
achievements.summary: Get Sam Fisher's outfit during the Government Plane Wreck expedition.

guide.context: Where you start in the expedition is random.

steps.text: Upgrade the Expeditions facility in @loc{Prosperity}, talk to the helicopter pilot there, and start the expedition from the Journal.
Start the Government Plane Wreck expedition (the 5th). Look for the rusted brown plane body that still has two wings and a blue ladder, and go inside.
Use the laptop on the ground floor, next to the only enemy there. A hidden vault opens upstairs.
Climb to the upper floor and use the vault door at the far end of the room. The outfit is inside.

achievements.description: Find all the Dear Photograph locations and see Hope County as it used to be. Host only.
achievements.summary: Line up all 9 Dear Photographs at their locations.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. First pick up Tracey's Shoebox upstairs in the main building at @loc{Prosperity}, next to the piano. Upgrade the Cartography Center and buy the Dear Photograph map to see the spots. At each spot, stand on the yellow camera mat, face the way the camera points, then hold the prompt to pull out the picture and line it up. The screen flashes when it is right.

collectibles.location: Just outside @loc{Prosperity}
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 2
collectibles.location: At Rye & Daughter Aviation
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 3
collectibles.location: At the Chop Shop outpost
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 4
collectibles.location: At the Refinery outpost
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 5
collectibles.location: At Sergey's place, by the river, looking toward the broken bridge
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 6
collectibles.location: At The Pantry outpost
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 7
collectibles.location: At Chateau Boshaw
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 8
collectibles.location: At the Old Compound church
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

collectibles.name: Photograph 9
collectibles.location: At Joseph's Sanctuary
collectibles.method: Line up the picture from the camera mat.

achievements.description: Rediscover some sweet tunes for the new world. Find all hidden MP3 players. Host only.
achievements.summary: Find all 10 hidden MP3 players.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it. They are listed from south to north, and you hear a player when you get close. Upgrade the Cartography Center in @loc{Prosperity} and buy the map to see them. Some need the Grapple perk.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Bradbury Woods}, a single cabin.
collectibles.method: Break the wooden plank wall in the corner with your fists or a weapon. The headphones are behind it.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 2
collectibles.location: @loc{Big Mike's Dale}, behind the house.
collectibles.method: Lift the hatch at the back of the house and go down into the bunker.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 3
collectibles.location: @loc{Fillmore's Hovel}, the building here.
collectibles.method: Open the hatch to the underground bunker.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 4
collectibles.location: @loc{Lake north of The Chop Shop}, one building by the lake.
collectibles.method: The building door is locked. Swim around the back and grapple in through the window (needs the Grapple perk).

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 5
collectibles.location: @loc{Frobishner's Memory}, a cave.
collectibles.method: Look up at the ceiling for a grapple hook and use it to reach the player one floor up (needs the Grapple perk).

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 6
collectibles.location: @loc{Sergey's place}, a broken train compartment.
collectibles.method: Look inside the broken train compartment.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 7
collectibles.location: @loc{Sein's Sanctuary}, the garden area.
collectibles.method: Break the wooden floorboards in the garden to reveal it.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 8
collectibles.location: @loc{Rotgut Pass}, a house.
collectibles.method: Open the locked door with the Lock Picking perk, or take the key from the shelf across from the door.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 9
collectibles.location: @loc{Forgotten Barracks}, a house west of the Empty Garden outpost.
collectibles.method: Open the locked door with Lock Picking. Or smash the boards beneath the table to find the key.

collectibles.name: MP3 Player 10
collectibles.location: @loc{Tombwater}, a house.
collectibles.method: Open the locked door with Lock Picking, or shoot the fridge freezer door to get the key.

achievements.description: Make Prosperity better than ever! Build all Infrastructure upgrades available. Host only.
achievements.summary: Build every infrastructure upgrade in Prosperity.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Recruit all 5 Specialists. The story requires this in Act 2.

Spend Ethanol to take each of the eight facilities to Level 3. They are the Garage, Training Camp and Workbench, plus the Infirmary and Expeditions. The last three are the Explosive Lab, Healing Garden and Cartography.
The fastest Ethanol comes from capturing outposts and scavenging them again and again.

achievements.description: Collect at least one skin from every type of animal in Hope County. Not creepy at all.
achievements.summary: Skin one of each of the 25 animal types in Hope County.

guide.context: Birds, ducks, turkeys, sheep, goats, hens, roosters and other fish do not count. Upgrade the Cartography Center in Prosperity and buy the hunting maps to see most hunting spots. Timber marks nearby animals, and the Binoculars perk marks runners from a distance. Keep one skin of each so progress counts. Skins from an expedition are saved only if you finish the expedition.

collectibles.name: Skunk
collectibles.location: @loc{Alcatraz Island} expedition, in a yellow padlocked cell on the second floor.
collectibles.method: Break a cell lock and kill the skunk before it escapes. Its cell is random, so try them all, and restart the expedition if it is missing. Complete the expedition so the skin is kept.

collectibles.name: Rattlesnake
collectibles.location: Waiting at a treasure hunt cave mouth, or during Selene's recruitment mission.
collectibles.method: Kill it and skin it.

collectibles.location: @loc{I.S.S. Crash Site} expedition, or roaming Hope County near the boat shed by Prosperity.
collectibles.method: Mark it with Timber or the Binoculars and shoot it with a bow before it spots you. In the expedition, finish it to keep the skin.

collectibles.name: Cattle
collectibles.location: Old Fang Farm, or by the lighthouse in the @loc{H.M.S. MacCoubrey} expedition.
collectibles.method: A cattle spot can spawn a bull instead of a cow. If no cow appears at the lighthouse, quit and restart the expedition, then check again. Finish it to keep the skin.

collectibles.name: Bull
collectibles.location: The same cattle spots as the cow.
collectibles.method: Each spawn is randomly a cow or a bull. Kill a bull and skin it.

collectibles.name: Crocodile
collectibles.location: Swamp water in the Government Plane Wreck or Five Stars Theme Park expeditions, or in Selene's recruitment mission.
collectibles.method: Kill it and skin it. In an expedition, finish it to keep the skin.

collectibles.name: Shark
collectibles.location: Water around the carrier in @loc{H.M.S. MacCoubrey}, or around Alcatraz Island.
collectibles.method: Kill it and dive down to loot the skin. Finish the expedition to keep it.

achievements.description: Complete 7 unique Expeditions on the Rank III difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete all 7 unique Expeditions at Rank III.

guide.context: Each win raises an Expedition from Rank I to II to III, so you play each one three times. Three stars show once Rank III is done. Bring legendary weapons, medkits and smoke grenades.

steps.text: There are 7 Expeditions: Five Stars Theme Park, Alcatraz Island, H.M.S. MacCoubrey and Navajo Bridge, plus Walking Horse Nuclear Plant, I.S.S. Crash Site and Government Plane Wreck.
Play each one three times, from Rank I through Rank III. You do not need to repeat one that already has three stars.

achievements.description: Liberate a Rank III Outpost while staying undetected.
achievements.summary: Capture a Rank III outpost without being detected.

guide.context: Only you must stay unnoticed. The achievement still unlocks if a Gun for Hire kills enemies noisily.

steps.text: Capture an outpost and scavenge it twice to make it Rank III, with purple enemies and two Enforcers.

Buy the Master Takedowns perk. Craft the Blood Dragon Recurve Bow, a legendary weapon whose arrows kill purple enemies in one hit. Avoid sniper rifles, which can leave a victim bleeding for 30 seconds and alert others.
Do it at Signal Point, the smallest outpost, which has plenty of cover. Shoot the regular enemies with arrows.
Use stealth melee takedowns on the two Enforcers, because one arrow will not kill them.

achievements.description: Liberate all Outposts at least once on Rank III.
achievements.summary: Capture each of the 10 outposts at Rank III at least once.

guide.context: Outposts show black smoke on the map. Destroy the alarm switches first so detected enemies cannot call backup. A bow gives silent kills.

steps.text: Capture an outpost, scavenge it, and capture it again until you have captured it at Rank III (purple icon, three stars).
Do this for all 10 outposts.

achievements.description: Craft 3 weapons. They don't need to look good, they just need to get the job done!
achievements.summary: Craft 3 weapons.

steps.text: Use a workbench in @loc{Prosperity} or in a captured outpost to make any 3 weapons, whatever their rarity. Expedition rewards are the quickest source of materials.

achievements.description: Successfully catch one of every type of fish in Hope County. Get those omega-3s.
achievements.summary: Catch one of each of the 6 fish types in Hope County.

guide.context: The six fish are available from Act 1. One catch of each type is enough, at any rarity. Each fish gives 1 perk point.

steps.text: Buy the Fishing Rod perk. The Outdoor Enthusiast perk makes fishing easier.
Buy the fishing map at the Cartography Center in @loc{Prosperity} to see the fishing spots.

At a spot, put the rod in the water and tap the cast button briefly to wobble the lure. Repeat until something bites, hook it, and start reeling. Whenever the fish drags to one side, push the stick to the opposite side. Low-difficulty spots are easier.

achievements.description: Recruit Horatio. Don't mind his temper, he can be pig-headed sometimes. Host only.
achievements.summary: Recruit Horatio the boar.

guide.context: Host only: in co-op, only the host earns it.

steps.text: Head to @loc{Elsinore Farm}, north-west of The Pantry outpost, where @mechanic{To Love a Boar} begins as a side mission.
Shoot the padlock on the shed and pet @npc{Horatio} so he joins you.

achievements.description: Use 3 smoke grenades.
achievements.summary: Use 3 smoke grenades.

steps.text: Open Throwables on the weapon wheel and craft smoke grenades from Yucca and Black Powder. Black Powder comes from looting enemies and containers, or trading animal skins and fish.
Throw 3 of them.

achievements.description: Headshot an Enforcer with Piercing Ammo.
achievements.summary: Shoot an Enforcer in the head with Piercing Ammo.

steps.text: Upgrade the workbench in @loc{Prosperity} and craft an Epic (purple) or Legendary (yellow) assault rifle or light machine gun. Weaker weapons cannot use Piercing Ammo.
At the workbench choose Refill Special Ammo to buy Piercing Ammo, then switch to it on the weapon wheel.
Find an @enemy{Enforcer}: there are two at every Rank III outpost, and one arrives as reinforcements at a detected Rank II outpost. Land one headshot.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Expeditions with a co-op partner.
achievements.summary: Finish 3 Expeditions while playing co-op with a partner.

guide.context: You do not need to be the host.

steps.text: Upgrade the Expeditions facility in @loc{Prosperity} and talk to the helicopter pilot there.
Invite a friend from the title screen, or from the Online tab in the game menu. There is no matchmaking, so you need someone to play with.
Start Expeditions from the Journal and finish 3 together.

achievements.displayName: Bring a Knife to a Gun Fight
achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies using any type of takedown. Put that railroad spike to good use!
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies using takedowns.

guide.context: Higher-ranked enemies need the matching Takedown perk from the Perks menu. Resetting outposts gives you more enemies to farm.

steps.text: Sneak up on enemies and use the takedown, or drop on them from above. Check progress in the Pause Menu under Ubisoft Club, then Stats. It may unlock a few kills after 25.

achievements.description: Kill your first Enforcer. I'm sure this will send the Highwaymen a good message.
achievements.summary: Kill one Enforcer.

steps.text: Get detected at any outpost so @enemy{Enforcers} (yellow health bar) appear, then kill one.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies by throwing a shield at them.
achievements.summary: Throw a shield to kill 5 enemies.

guide.context: Your kills are saved only when you capture the outpost. If you die or restart the checkpoint first, the count resets. Capture and scavenge the outpost to respawn the Brawlers.

steps.text: Go to The Island, the northernmost outpost, at Rank III. It has three Brawlers: one in the north-east corner and two on the patrol boat.
Kill a @enemy{Brawler} and pick up its shield with the prompt on screen.

Damage an enemy first, since a thrown shield may not kill at full health. Throw the shield at it, then pick the shield up and throw again. Put the shield away when you are not using it, because shots destroy it.

achievements.description: Purchase the 5th tier of a stackable perk. You can never have enough.
achievements.summary: Buy the 5th level of a stackable perk.

steps.text: Open Perks and buy More Lung Capacity five times, at 3 points each. More Medkits or More Light/Heavy Ammo cost 4 points each.

achievements.description: No wings means less drag, right? Take a short flight in the wingless plane.
achievements.summary: Fly the wingless plane briefly.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{The Ryeunion} to unlock the wingless plane, and spawn it from a boat shed.
Craft Dynamite under Throwables on the weapon wheel.
Drive on water at top speed, throw the dynamite just ahead, and drive over it as it explodes. The blast throws the plane into the air.
Stay alive and keep the plane from being destroyed. Dynamite works; stronger explosives can wreck it.

achievements.description: Kill 10 brawlers with any saw launcher. They never saw it coming.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Brawlers with saw launchers.

guide.context: Kills from different saw launchers add together. They are saved only when you capture the outpost, so dying or restarting the checkpoint first loses them.

steps.text: Get a saw launcher. The mission for @npc{Grace} gives you the first one.
Go to The Island at Rank III. It has three @enemy{Brawlers}: one in the north-east corner and two on the patrol boat. The legendary Saw Launcher V.T kills them in one hit.
Capture and scavenge the outpost to respawn them, and repeat until you reach 10.

achievements.description: Craft your first Legendary Weapon or Vehicle and start a legend of your own.
achievements.summary: Craft a Legendary weapon or vehicle.

steps.text: Use Ethanol to raise the Weapon Workbench (weapons) or the Garage (vehicles) in @loc{Prosperity} to Level 3. Craft any Legendary (yellow) item. Expeditions are the quickest source of crafting materials.

achievements.description: Knock an enemy's helmet off with a charged melee attack.
achievements.summary: Use a charged melee hit to knock a helmet off an enemy.

guide.context: Only tier 2 and higher enemies (blue, purple or yellow health bar) wear helmets. Masks and thrown weapons do not count.

steps.text: Equip your bare hands on the weapon wheel. Hold the melee button to charge it and hit the enemy in the head.

achievements.description: Eliminate 10 enemies within a single activation of Wrath.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies during a single use of Wrath.

guide.context: Only tap the Wrath button to activate it, because holding it ends Wrath.

steps.text: Buy the Wrath, Eden's Touch and Master Takedowns perks once Act 2 makes them available. Takedowns refill the Wrath meter through Eden's Touch.
Go to the Signal Point outpost at Rank III. It is small and its enemies stand close together.
Run in, take down one enemy, and let the others see you so they rush you.
Activate Wrath and keep using takedowns until you have 10 kills before it ends. If no takedown prompt appears, circle an enemy while punching until you are behind him.

achievements.description: Perform an Aerial Takedown after using Leap of Faith.
achievements.summary: Do an aerial takedown right after a Leap of Faith jump.

steps.text: Buy the Leap of Faith perk once Act 2 makes it available.
Sneak up to a standing enemy at an outpost, double-jump above them, and press the takedown button.

achievements.description: Unlock the first level for all Perks.
achievements.summary: Unlock the first level of all 30 perks.

guide.context: An Act 2 story mission opens the last row of perks. Buying level 1 of every perk costs 182 Perk Points altogether.

steps.text: Earn Perk Points from challenges such as weapon kills. The 10 Treasure Hunts give 30 points.
Buy the first level of every perk in the Perks menu.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy more than 100m away with a basic arrow.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy more than 100 m away with a basic arrow.

steps.text: At a Level 3 workbench, make the Lucky Shot Compound Bow, a legendary weapon. Its sight corrects for arrow drop over distance.
Head for The Watering Hole outpost in the north-east, where guards stand out in the open.
Use the Binoculars perk to put a waypoint on an enemy and check that it is over 100 m away. Then shoot a standing enemy.

achievements.description: Finish off an Enforcer with a bayonet.
achievements.summary: Land the killing blow on an Enforcer with a bayonet melee strike.

guide.context: If Eden's Touch keeps giving you normal knife takedowns, let the Enforcer throw you to the ground, then aim at his chest and use melee.

steps.text: Craft an assault rifle that has a bayonet. Two examples are the blue Makeshift AK-47 and the legendary Radiation-Pink AK-MS, which hits harder in melee.
Find an @enemy{Enforcer}: there are two at every Rank III outpost, and one arrives as reinforcements at a detected Rank II outpost.
Shoot him to lower his health, then finish him with the bayonet melee attack. It cannot be a sneak attack.

achievements.description: Survive a 30m fall using only Leap of Faith to nullify the impact.
achievements.summary: Survive a 30 m fall using only Leap of Faith.

steps.text: Buy the Leap of Faith perk once Act 2 makes it available.
Either leap out of a helicopter, or use an air drop to reach a fast travel point. The air drop needs the upgraded Expeditions facility.
Press jump once just before you land to cancel the fall damage.
